2607.14049.title: Deep Interaction: An Efficient Human-AI Interaction Method for Large Reasoning Models
2607.14049.paper_summary: The emergence of Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning has significantly enhanced the ability of large language models (LLMs) to tackle complex, multi-step tasks. However, when errors occur, current interaction approaches typically involve re-generating another response that may make mistakes again, or users laboriously flag the faulty step in follow-up turns that may get responses <You are right, I made a mistake here> followed by similar errors recurring. To address this issue, we propose an efficient human intervention mechanism for precisely correcting reasoning errors in LLMs, termed Deep Interaction. Our approach enables direct editing of the original response, allowing erroneous parts to be corrected while preserving accurate reasoning steps. We refine the edited CoT into a distilled prompt, which then steers the LLM along the corrected reasoning path. Experimental results show that our method achieves over a 25% improvement in correction success rate and reduces token usage by approximately 40% on STEM tasks reasoning compared to baseline approaches.
2607.14049.paper_summary_zh: 鏈結思維（Chain-of-Thought, CoT）推理的出現顯著增強了大型語言模型（LLMs）處理複雜多步任務的能力。<lb/>然而，當發生錯誤時，目前的互動方式通常涉及重新生成另一個可能再次出錯的回應，或者用戶在後續回合中費力地標記錯誤步驟，這可能會得到類似「你是對的，我在這裡犯了錯」的回應，隨後類似的錯誤又會重現。<lb/>為了解決這個問題，我們提出了一種高效的人類干預機制，用於精確地糾正LLMs中的推理錯誤，稱為深度互動（Deep Interaction）。<lb/>我們的方法允許對原始回應進行直接編輯，從而在保留準確推理步驟的同時修正錯誤部分。<lb/>我們將編輯後的CoT精煉為一個提煉提示，然後引導LLM沿著修正的推理路徑進行。<lb/>實驗結果顯示，我們的方法在糾正成功率上提高了超過25%，並且在STEM任務推理中相比基線方法減少了約40%的標記使用。
